pages.title: Miniaturiser
pages.text: A ring of lenses round a capsule, after the 1966 film Fantastic Voyage: it shrinks whoever stands in it until a body's cells are the size of houses, and sets them down inside one. Used in the Overworld it takes you into Inner Space; used there, it brings you back out.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Pharmacokinetics.
